fieldDescription: Master switch for the industries that have a switch in the Industries tab. Off is the same as turning all of them off; built industries stay. On, each industry follows its own switch. NPC placement needs a new game.

The row amount in most of the ship picker dialogues in the mod.
Chance for a meteor shower to spawn. One month has 10 ticks, 2 percent per tick = 18 %% chance per month = 92 %% per year. Increasing this by 0.1 raises monthly odds by about 30 %%, so use caution.
How likely a system is to have an artillery station. Reduce this number to make them rarer. 1 = between 5-10%% of all systems will have one. Needs a new game.
Amount of additional stations with custom types spawned on top of existing ones (0.2 = 20%% additional). Needs a new game.
Amount of Coronal Taps * number = amount of automated shipyards. Default taps is 2, so default shipyards is 3 (2 * 1.5). Rounds up. Needs a new game.

Master chance for a special event to be applied to an entity that does not have one. Note that the chance is actually lower as every entity has a defined chance to resolve to nothing. Needs a new game.
